Subject: Audit logs / evidence for PII access - follow up

Marissa,

Thanks for the call earlier - appreciate the clear overview of Redwood's runtime and routing options. A couple of follow-ups from our security and compliance team:

1) We need a sample of the audit logs that show who accessed what data and when (including any export events). Preferably CSV and JSONL examples.
2) Confirmation of default retention for audit logs and options for extended retention (we may need 7+ years for certain regulated products).
3) Details on data residency and whether audit exports can be scoped to our AWS account / S3 bucket.
4) A short summary of the RBAC/least-privilege controls and how access to logs is restricted.

Can you share sample exports and the SOC2/compliance summary you referenced on the call? Also what is the timeline to provide a 30-day export for our fincobank-prod workspace - procurement wants to validate prior to contract signing.

Thanks,
Samir Shah
Director, Information Security
FinCo Bank

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Audit logs / evidence for PII access - follow up

Hi all - adding the technical details requested. Summary of what our audit logs capture and export options:

- Core fields in each audit record: timestamp (ISO8601), request_id, workspace_id, user_id (or service_account_id), actor_type (human/service/automated), model_id, API_route, operation (generate/embedding/upload/export), resource_id, action_result (success/failure), bytes_transferred, ip_address (hashed by default for exports), prompt_hash (we do not export raw prompt text by default unless explicitly requested), redaction_flags (PII_detection_score), and export_flag.
- Export formats: CSV, JSONL, Parquet. We can provide column/field mappings for each format.
- Retention: default audit log retention is 90 days for hosted accounts. For Dedicated/Private customers we can configure retention up to 7 years; extended retention is part of Enterprise contract (we support both cold storage and legal-hold workflows).
- Data residency & exports: Exports can be delivered to a customer-managed S3 bucket (SSE-KMS), to an SFTP endpoint, or as an encrypted CSV delivered via our secure transfer. Exports include a manifest and an md5 checksum.
- Access controls: audit-log access is RBAC-protected. Roles that can read exports are: account_admin, security_admin (read-only), and support_engineer (scoped, time-limited). All access is logged (who/when), and exports require an approval workflow for support_engineer-created exports.
- Evidence & compliance: we maintain SOC 2 artifacts and can provide the SOC 2 summary and info on periodic internal audits.

I've attached a small sample export (redwood-audit-logs-sample.csv) and our SOC 2 summary PDF for your review. If you want raw prompts included we need explicit authorization from FinCo (we can redact per-policy).

Let me know if you want column-level examples or a filtered sample scoped to fincobank-prod (provide workspace_id or account id).

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Staff Engineer, Platform
aditya_rao@redwood.com

Thanks Aditya and Marissa - this is helpful. A few follow-ups from our legal/procurement teams:

- For the 30-day export: pls deliver to our S3 bucket (fincobank-exports, us-east-1). We will provide the bucket role/ARN; prefer SSE-KMS.
- We need a short statement that exports delivered to our S3 will be scoped to fincobank-prod workspace_id only and exclude other customers.
- For access controls: can you share the IAM role names / permission sets used for support and security_admin roles so our IAM team can review?
- Timeline: procurement would like the export and SOC2 summary by EOD Tuesday 17 Mar to keep the contract on schedule. Can you confirm?

Also, do you have any sample query syntax we should use if we ask for ad-hoc queries (e.g., "last-access events for user X between dates")?

Samir

- IAM/permission sets: Aditya, can you paste the common role names and permission sets in your follow-up note? We'll attach as part of the procurement package.
- Ad-hoc queries: sample syntax attached (we've included a short RDW export instructions doc in the procurement folder) - I'll also share a short example query in a follow-up email.

I'll schedule a 30-minute handoff for Monday 16 Mar at 10am PT to walk through the export and hand over the manifest. If that doesn't work for procurement, we can do Tue 17 Mar EOD as a fallback.

Deliverables we will provide by Tue 17 Mar: scoped 30-day export to your S3, export manifest, SOC2 summary PDF, and IAM role/permission list.

Best,
Marissa
